caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a ceramic or clay model of a bird, positioned on a flat, oval-shaped base. The bird is shown in a side profile with its head turned slightly forward. The body of the bird is primarily white with a pattern of small red and brown spots on its chest and neck. The bird’s beak is dark brown, and there are distinct red lines outlining the wings and running along the bird’s back. The wings are shaded in brown, with gradient tones towards yellow at the edges, and the tail feathers are also brown that fade to yellow at the tips. The base on which the bird stands is light grey and shadowed to give a three-dimensional effect. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige, and a faint rectangular border outlines the entire composition.
title: Chalkware Pigeon Figurine
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
